chapter: Charleston childhood and the Jenkins Orphanage
title: Private pupil of Eugene Mikell in Charleston
summary: He knew the orphanage because his teacher Eugene Mikell taught there and also took private pupils, including Briggs, and organised church bands.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Let me just take you back, so I can get the dates here straight. So, were you associated with that band at all or just knew about it?
No. I knew about it for the simple reason that Mr. ---the man who taught me music, Mr. Eugene Mikell was a teacher, one of the teachers of the Jenkins Orphanage.
But he had also private pupils, and I was one of -- well, I became one of his private pupils, you see.

So I knew of the orphanage and I knew just what he was doing, because he even stretched his musical intuition to the churches, organized bands and things, to take the youngsters in hand and teach them
